columns.name: Hub and shared-user requests
columns.instruction: Describe the switch or hub topology and supported request types. State whether two bipartite requests sharing a user, such as A–B and A–C, are explicitly modeled or evaluated. Distinguish an explicit case from a general model that might accommodate it.

columns.name: Age-dependent swap choice
columns.instruction: Describe the swap-partner selection rule and the state it uses. Identify whether stored link age actually affects partner selection, rather than only memory allocation, request priority, or performance evaluation.

columns.name: Age metric and objective
columns.instruction: Give the definition of each age metric used as a scheduling objective and state what is minimized or maximized. Distinguish stored-link age, delivered-entanglement age, request waiting time, and age of entanglement establishment; do not treat them as interchangeable.

columns.name: Memory cutoff model
columns.instruction: Describe any maximum storage age, expiration rule, and cutoff value, including units when stated. Separately identify memory-capacity limits and gradual decoherence; neither alone establishes a hard storage-age cutoff. Report distinct model variants separately.

columns.name: Delivery-rate floor
columns.instruction: Record any explicit lower-bound constraint on long-run successful entanglement deliveries, including its averaging definition and whether it applies per request or in aggregate. Distinguish this constraint from throughput maximization, queue stability, and measured delivery rates.

columns.name: Attempt budget
columns.instruction: Record any explicit budget on generation attempts or swap attempts. Identify the counted action, bound, and time horizon or averaging rule. Distinguish an attempt budget from a memory-register limit or batches of attempts without a budget.

columns.name: Underwater optical setting
columns.instruction: Identify the physical link medium and state whether the scheduling model is explicitly formulated or evaluated for underwater optical quantum links. Describe any underwater channel assumptions used; do not infer underwater applicability from a generic optical-link model.

columns.name: Publication evidence
columns.instruction: Record explicit publication information stated in the source, such as journal or proceedings venue, publication date, and publication status. Distinguish published work from a submitted manuscript or preprint; do not infer publication from a manuscript date alone.
